raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "rent"
  role subject "James"
  role object "the vineyard near Sibiu"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "plant"
  role subject "Ms Gheorghiu"
  role object "peppers"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "be a member of"
  role subject "Ana"
  role object "the youth choir"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s4 stated
  relation "be a member of"
  role subject "Mr Romero"
  role object "the Madrigal choir"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s5 stated
  relation "be a member of"
  role subject "Botond"
  role object "the gospel choir"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted

@q query
  where match
    relation "cook at"
    role subject "Ayşe Şahin"
    role object "Sala Moara Veche"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  where match
    relation "sing in"
    role subject "Kavya"
    role object "the opera chorus"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@s6 stated
  relation "cook at"
  role subject "Kenji Watanabe"
  role object "Grădina Botanică din Kraków"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q3 query
  where match
    relation "cook at"
    role subject "Kenji Watanabe"
    role object "Grădina Botanică din Kraków"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q4 query
  select ?t
  where match
    relation "rent"
    role subject "Lucian"
    role object "the field next to the river"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q5 query
  where match
    relation "rent"
    role subject "Hassan"
    role object "the garage behind the building"
    polarity negated
  end
